70s Retro Cinematic:
A 70s-inspired aesthetic with saturated warm tones, retro interiors, dynamic motion, and cinematic styling — featuring shag carpeting, mustard and earth-toned outfits, funky energy, and a joyful, nostalgic vibe. 
Lighting: Warm, directional.
Lens: Vintage 50mm f/2.0.
Textures: Rich, tactile, soft glow on highlights.
Mood: Cinematic, editorial, nostalgic.
Vintage Editorial Amber:
Editorial cinematic photograph with vintage 70s color grading and a warm burnt orange table. 
Lens: 50mm, f/2.0 aperture.
Lighting: Strong directional warm lighting, subtle exposure bloom, slight dirty lens effect for vintage feel.
Textures: Rich surfaces — whiskey glass, ice cubes — with soft highlight glows.
Mood: Tactile, elegant, retro-modern, editorial.
Bright Studio Pop:
A hyperrealistic editorial-style photograph using a medium-wide angle lens (35mm).
Lighting: Studio tri-light softbox, high-key, radiant skin tones, minimal harsh shadows.
Textures: Bold, saturated primary colors, retro-modern fashion with a pop-art flair.
Composition: Dynamic asymmetry, playful confident poses.
Post: Subtle gloss, clean color separation, slight filmic grain.
Mood: Cheerful, charismatic, dynamic advertising.
Flash Cinematic Editorial:
Hyperrealistic editorial-style vertical flash photograph, 1350x1080 format.
Lens: Wide, cinematic (Wes Anderson and Spike Jonze style influences).
Lighting: Harsh direct flash, sculptural shadows, hyperreal surfaces (skin, fabric, plastic, metal).
Textures: Crisp highlights, slight film grain.
Backgrounds: Deep maroon, vivid mid blue, blurred but colorful.
Mood: Offbeat, surreal editorial realism with playful or exaggerated poses.
Vibrant Pop Art:
Hyperrealistic editorial pop-art photograph.
Lighting: Bright, tri-light setup for a clean, high-contrast and glossy finish.
Textures: Sharp surfaces — satin, plastic, skin — with punchy vivid primary colors.
Composition: Wide shots with surreal stacked compositions, humorously exaggerated.
Lens: Medium-wide (35mm), slightly exaggerated spatial feel.
Mood: Energetic, surreal but stylish, pop art editorial style.
Moody 70s Still Life:
Moody, cinematic editorial still life.
Lighting: Hard directional side lighting with intense shadows and smoke effects.
Textures: Matte surfaces like ceramic and egg yolk with high specularity for dramatic shadows.
Lens: Medium focal length with shallow depth.
Mood: Retro 70s mood, editorial surrealism with subtle humor and elegance.
Colors: Muted warm tones, deep reds, shadows emphasized.
High-Contrast Action B&W:
Hyperrealistic monochrome (black and white) action photography.
Lighting: Overexposed flash for blown highlights, dusty and dirty textures emphasized.
Shutter Speed: 1/60th of a second for dramatic motion blur.
Textures: Grainy expired film, heavy dust clouds, spinning tire marks.
Mood: Nostalgic, gritty, intense, dramatic movement captured tightly in frame.
Subjects: F1 cars, astronauts, high-speed action scenes.
Futuristic Sports Editorial:
Cinematic hyperrealistic sports portrait in low light.
Lighting: Hard rim lights with glowing blue edges, plus diffused soft front fill.
Textures: Matte racing suits, glossy helmets, metallic accents.
Exposure: High contrast with vignetting, subtle glow around edges.
Lens: 50mm at f/1.8 for creamy bokeh and sharp subject detail.
Mood: Heroic, precise, futuristic, cyberpunk-flavored sports editorial.
